runs.name: Chesapeake Utilities Corporation; NYSE CPK, SEC CIK 0000019745, Delaware; regulated natural gas and electric distribution and gas transmission with propane and other unregulated energy, Mid-Atlantic, the Carolinas, Florida and Ohio; Florida City Gas bought 2023-11-30
runs.entry: Price **$132.18** (close 2026-10-16, `tools/run.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares 24,106,455 common on the cover of the 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (0001628280-26-054477, as of 2026-08-03), `Screens/cover_shares.py` agreeing; treasury stock only the Rabbi Trust deferred-compensation shares; the $225,000,000 at-the-market program with forward sales of 2026-10-01 (8-K 0001193125-26-409820, 424B5 0001193125-26-409381) with no sale filed, not counted. Sovereign for the earnings currency (USD) **5.43%**, US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-16. Read from the FY2025 10-K (0001628280-26-011753, filed 2026-02-25), the FY2022 to FY2024 10-Ks, the 10-Q for 2026-06-30, the proxy of 2026-03-25 (0001628280-26-020945) and the 8-Ks of 2026-07-13 (Florida Energy Pathway, about $1.2 billion), 2026-08-06, 2026-09-01 (49% of the project sold to a NextEra Energy Resources subsidiary, no proceeds stated, a guaranty of about $109M of contributions), 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-01. Cross-check: 2025 operating cash $233.7M on the filed cash-flow statement equals the tagged figure; 2022 $158,882 thousand likewise. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the FY2025 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7, stated in the run file. **Q1 IN**: Regulated Energy decides at 84% of five-year segment operating income ($765.9M of $907.4M), earnings of rate base times allowed return, allowed ROE 9.50% to 10.25% in Delaware and Florida, 6.88% allowed rate of return in Maryland. **Q2 IN**: a franchise with no direct rival for homes and businesses in its territories, every rate case since 2022 granted below the ask, the Florida Supreme Court rejecting the consumer advocate's appeal of the Florida City Gas order in June 2026; returns ordinary and regulated, carried to Q3 as a second best. Comparables chosen as a CONVENTION of the run from the proxy peer group (the 10-K names no rival): ONE Gas, Northwest Natural and Unitil, 2021 to 2025 return on equity 8.5%, 7.7% and 9.1% against CPK's 9.9% (about 11% before Florida City Gas, 8.4% to 9.4% after); the whole field spends more than its operating cash. **Q3 WEIGHS AGAINST**: capital added 2021 to 2025, purchase price included, earned about 5.7% after tax, near the 5.43% Treasury. **Q4 no STOP, WEIGHS AGAINST**: ten balance sheets read, assets $1.23B to $3.99B, of the $1,152M rise in equity about $717M from new stock, goodwill $508M after Florida City Gas, debt $359M to $1,620M ($1,688M at 2026-06-30), cash never above $8M; depreciation on two cash-flow lines and a 2024 regulatory credit of $15.5M reversed. **Q5 integrity IN** (EPS guidance and an adjusted EPS, small and reconciled). **Q6 WEIGHS AGAINST** on both parts: half the officers' long-term award pays on capital spending as a share of capitalization (the 2023 to 2025 award at maximum), the ROE half measured excluding Florida City Gas; Florida City Gas, bought for $922.8M cash, earned $5.2M net income in 2025. **Q7 OUT**: owner cash before interest after maintenance (total depreciation on both lines) averaging $135.4M 2021 to 2025, after all capital spending -$39.1M; the serial-acquirer convention tripped by the one purchase, so the central figure is the organic pair, the growth end built from growth spending of $174.6M a year at 6.82% as a CONVENTION of the run (the filer reports no organic rate); net debt $1,687.3M; **value range $33.47 to $47.46 a share** all-equity (equity-only $78.58 to $100.37) against $132.18, expected returns 2.78% to 3.70%, at most 5.17% on the most generous case built, the price above the top; **fair price -$20.89 all-equity, not positive** (at ten percent the business is worth less than its net debt at both ends), **$42.39 equity-only**; **not armed**: the all-equity figure is not positive and the central figure is already the organic pair; whether to arm the equity-only figure is left to the operator. After the stop, facts recorded, not weighed: debt $1,687.7M gross against equity $1,673.4M at 2026-06-30, revolver enlarged to $650M in August 2026, a 65% funded-debt covenant, planned 2026 spending $550M to $600M plus its share of the pipeline, total return since 2020 $127 per $100 against $183 for the industry index. Contamination declared by the analyst: CPYYY commit subjects, AYI and ARCB folder names, memory index lines and a file count of `Test Runs/`, none used. Commits 72baff39 (Step 0 and Q1), d9fe2e12 (Q2), dc47def5 (Q3), a50d9976 (Q4), e85ac0ac (Q5), 3996b6f0 (Q6), c024ca79 (Q7), fccb3177 (the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_run.py` 68 ids, 0 problems; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` 68 ids, 28 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; no E-ids; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): the serial-acquirer convention catches a single cash deal, and its organic-growth prescription has nothing to read where the filer reports no organic rate; (e) names no return for growth spending the filing does not split; Part VII does not say what to report when the fair price is negative and the run is already on the organic pair; the regulated-return exception at Q2 meets a floor that closes any utility priced near or above book OUT at Q7, unsaid; `tools/run.py` misses the second depreciation line and its debt column includes equity. Could not get: a maintenance capex figure, an organic growth rate, the proceeds of the 49% sale, the outcome of the pending Florida City Gas rate case; peer figures are tagged data, flagged as transcription.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on price (Chesapeake Utilities Corporation, NYSE CPK, regulated gas and electric distribution and gas transmission with propane, Florida City Gas bought 2023; Q1 and Q2 IN, a franchise at regulated, ordinary returns carried as a second best; Q3, Q4 and Q6 weigh against: about 5.7% after tax on added capital, equity and debt raised to fund spending, Florida City Gas earning $5.2M on $922.8M, officers paid half their long-term award on capital spending; Q5 integrity IN. Value range $33.47 to $47.46 a share all-equity on the organic pair against $132.18, expected returns 2.78% to 3.70%, at most 5.17%; fair price -$20.89 all-equity, not positive, $42.39 equity-only; not armed, the equity-only alert left to the operator. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: the serial-acquirer test on one deal with no organic rate filed, (e)'s return on unsplit growth spending, a negative fair price, the regulated-return second best that the floor always closes, the tool's depreciation and debt columns.)
